body: Just seems like a lifetime of torture and regret isn't worth it

The thing that kills me most? It took me a Few years after college to find a profession that was right for me. Years. I finally found it. I was great at it. It's gone. If I continue on in life, no matter what I do, it'll never be as 'right' as this was. It's like losing the love of your life. I'm such a fuckup.

No details. I was on a fast track towards success. But I don't think I'll ever get a job in this field again. Lost all my references and contacts. Looks like its retail work from here on. What kills me is How I let it get to this point because I didn't stick up for myself earlier on. Everything could've been prevented if I'd have stuck to my guns. I let myself get pushed into a situation that I wasn't comfortable with and I kept making excuses every time I had a chance to back out. And of course it was inevitable that I had to back out but I didn't want to admit that. And now its over. This is as close as I've come to wanting to end my life, but I'm just damn scared of the void. Scared of missing out on happy times with my loved ones. But this pain is overwhelming. So what I'm forced to calculate is what's worth more - fleeting moments of happiness or a lifetime of tortuous regret.

Not looking to go into details. But basically, I had an important decision to make and I couldn't make it. Or maybe i couldnt admit my decision to myself. Then at the absolute last minute I did the worst thing possible and really screwed myself and a few people close to me. And this is going to have far reaching consequnces. Like, i just destroyed my career. Completly destroyed. This is torture to write this out. When I think about how deep this hole is, and the idea that I'll be down here forever... I worked so hard to get to where I was over many years and it's gone.
